common.title: Universal Game Engine
common.select_game_desc: Select a game to see available rooms or start a new match.
common.login_desc: Enter your username to start playing.
common.be_the_first: Be the first to start a new match in this category!
common.choose_join_mode: Choose whether to play or spectate.

tictactoe.name: Tic Tac Toe
tictactoe.rules: Players take turns putting their marks (X or O) in the 3x3 grid. The first player to get 3 marks in a row wins.

summary.label: How to Play
summary.title: Connect 3 to Win!
summary.content: Tic Tac Toe is a simple game on a 3x3 grid. You play as O or X, trying to get 3 of your marks in a line!

rules.label: Rules
rules.title: Take Turns!
rules.content:
1. On your turn, place your mark in any empty square.
2. You cannot place your mark where someone has already played.

win.label: Winning
win.title: Aim for a Line!
win.content: You win if you get 3 of your marks in a horizontal, vertical, or diagonal row!

othello.name: Othello
othello.rules: Players take turns placing their colors on the board. Trapped opponent's colors are flipped. The player with more pieces wins.

summary.label: How to Play
summary.title: Trap and Flip!
summary.content: In Othello, you play as Black or White. Your goal is to 'trap' your opponent's pieces between your own. When you do, they flip to your color!

rules.label: Rules
rules.title: Where can I move?
rules.content:
1. You can only place a piece where it traps at least one opponent piece.
2. All trapped pieces are flipped to your color.
3. If you can't move, you must 'Pass'.
4. The game ends when the board is full or no one can move.

win.label: Winning
win.title: Most Pieces Wins!
win.content: At the end, count the pieces. If you have more pieces than your opponent, you win! Getting every piece on the board is called a 'Perfect Game'.

othello_3d.name: 3D Othello
othello_3d.rules: Similar to Othello but in a 3D grid. You can flip pieces in 26 directions including the Z-axis.

summary.label: How to Play
summary.title: Flip in 3D!
summary.content: This is Othello but in a 3D cube! You have to think about up, down, and all around to trap your opponent's pieces.

rules.label: Rules
rules.title: 26 Directions!
rules.content:
1. Place your piece to trap at least one opponent piece.
2. In 3D, you can trap pieces vertically, horizontally, diagonally, and even through the layers! There are 26 directions in total!

win.label: Winning
win.title: Look Behind!
win.content: The player with the most pieces at the end wins! Rotate the camera to find any hidden pieces in the cube.

high_low.name: High-Low Card
high_low.rules: Guess if the next card is higher or lower than the current one.

summary.label: How to Play
summary.title: Next Card: Big or Small?
summary.content: A simple card game where you guess the rank of the next card. Is it going to be higher or lower than the one on the table?

rules.label: Rules
rules.title: Know the Ranks!
rules.content:
1. Cards rank from A (lowest) up to K (highest).
2. Click 'High' if you think the next card is bigger, or 'Low' if you think it's smaller.

tips.label: Tips
tips.title: Check the Odds!
tips.content: If the current card is a '2', the next card is very likely to be 'High'! Think about what cards haven't appeared yet.

shogi.name: Shogi
shogi.rules: A traditional Japanese board game where you can use captured pieces as your own. Checkmate the opponent's King to win.

summary.label: How to Play
summary.title: Capture the King!
summary.content: Shogi is like Japanese Chess. Protect your King while trying to capture the opponent's King. The coolest part is that you can use pieces you capture as your own!

pieces.label: Pieces
pieces.title: Master the Moves!
pieces.content:
🚶 [Pawn] Moves 1 space forward.
🏇 [Knight] Jumps forward-diagonally.
🏯 [Rook] Moves any distance vertically or horizontally.
📐 [Bishop] Moves any distance diagonally.
👑 [King] Moves 1 space in any of the 8 directions.

rules.label: Special Rules
rules.title: Promotion and Drops!
rules.content:
1. [Promotion] When a piece enters the opponent's territory, it can become much stronger!
2. [Drops] You can place any piece you've captured back onto the board as your own piece on your turn.

chess.name: Chess
chess.rules: A classic strategy game. Move your pieces (King, Queen, Rooks, etc.) to checkmate the opponent's King.

summary.label: How to Play
summary.title: Become a Grandmaster!
summary.content: Chess is a game of strategy. Your goal is to trap the opponent's King while protecting your own. Lead your army to victory!

pieces.label: Pieces
pieces.title: Learn the Moves!
pieces.content:
👑 [King] Moves 1 space in any direction. Most important!
👸 [Queen] Moves any distance in any direction. Super strong!
🏰 [Rook] Moves any distance vertically or horizontally.
📐 [Bishop] Moves any distance diagonally.
🏇 [Knight] Jumps in an 'L' shape.
💂 [Pawn] Moves 1 space forward. Captures diagonally forward.

win.label: Winning
win.title: Checkmate!
win.content: When the opponent's King cannot escape capture, it's 'Checkmate' and you win the game!

daifugo.name: Daifugo
daifugo.rules: A card game where the goal is to get rid of all your cards. Ranks range from Daifugo (Grand Millionaire) to Daihinmin (Extreme Needy).

summary.label: How to Play
summary.title: Discard Quickly!
summary.content: In Daifugo, players take turns playing cards. The first person to run out of cards becomes the 'Daifugo' (the Grand Millionaire)!

ranks.label: Strength
ranks.title: Card Power Levels!
ranks.content:
In this game, '2' is the strongest and '3' is the weakest.
(Strong) 2 > A > K > Q ... > 4 > 3 (Weak)
*The Joker is special and stronger than any card!

special.label: Wild Rules
special.title: Revolutionize the Game!
special.content:
1. [8-Stop] Playing an '8' ends the round immediately and it's your turn again!
2. [Revolution] If someone plays 4 cards of the same number, the strength flips! '3' becomes the strongest card!

texas_holdem.name: Texas Hold'em
texas_holdem.rules: Make the best 5-card hand using 2 private cards and 5 community cards.

summary.label: How to Play
summary.title: Make the Best Hand!
summary.content: The most popular poker game! You get 2 hidden cards, and use them with 5 shared cards on the table to make the strongest 5-card combo.

hands.label: Hands
hands.title: Master the Combos!
hands.content:
✨ [Royal Flush] A, K, Q, J, 10 of the same suit. The best!
🌈 [Flush] 5 cards of the same suit.
🔢 [Straight] 5 cards in numerical order.
👫 [One Pair] 2 cards of the same number.

flow.label: Flow
flow.title: Bet Your Chips!
flow.content:
1. When you get cards, choose to 'Bet' chips if you feel strong.
2. Cards appear on the table in stages. Decide to stay in or 'Fold'.
3. The strongest hand at the end takes all the chips in the pot!

go.name: Go
go.rules: Surround more territory than your opponent to win.

summary.label: How to Play
summary.title: Surround Territory!
summary.content: Go is a game of space. You and your opponent place stones to 'fence off' parts of the board. The one with the most territory wins!

rules.label: Rules
rules.title: Capture Stones!
rules.content:
1. Take turns placing a stone on the intersections.
2. If you completely surround an opponent's stone, you capture it!
3. Once placed, stones cannot be moved.

win.label: Winning
win.title: Most Space Wins!
win.content: At the end, count the empty spaces inside your territory. More space means more points!

rubiks_cube.name: Rubik's Cube
rubiks_cube.rules: Solve the 3D puzzle by aligning all colors on each face.

summary.label: How to Play
summary.title: Solve the Cube!
summary.content: This is a classic 3D puzzle. Your goal is to scramble the cube and then get all the colors back to their original faces!

goal.label: Goal
goal.title: Match the Colors!
goal.content: Try to get each of the 6 faces to be one solid color. Start by solving one side first!

move.label: Controls
move.title: Rotate and Solve!
move.content: Click and drag on the cube to rotate a layer. Drag outside the cube to rotate your view. Can you solve it?

equilibrium.name: Equilibrium
equilibrium.rules: A strategic board game designed by AI. Read your opponent's mind to break the balance.

summary.label: What is it?
summary.title: A Battle of Souls and Minds!
summary.content: Equilibrium is a strategic card game designed by an AI. Use your HP and Soul Points (SP) wisely to reach your goal before your opponents do!

goals.label: How to Win
goals.title: Four Ways to Victory!
goals.content:
You win instantly if you achieve any ONE of these goals:
1. [Annihilator] Reduce opponent's HP to 0!
2. [Collector] Have 8 or more cards on your board!
3. [Pacifist] Everyone survives until turn 15!
4. [Soul Hoarder] Accumulate 25 or more Soul Points!

phases.label: Game Flow
phases.title: Two Phases Every Turn!
phases.content:
1. [Auction] Bid your Soul Points for the rare card in the center. The highest bidder gets the card!
2. [Main] Use cards from your hand by spending SP. You can attack, defend, or even 'Bluff' to trick your opponents!

cards.label: Card Types
cards.title: Master the 5 Card Types!
cards.content:
💥 [Attack] Reduces opponent's HP!
🛡️ [Defense] Restores your own HP!
🔮 [Trick] Special effects like discarding opponent's cards!
🎯 [Goal] Change your secret victory condition!
⚖️ [Syphon] Steal Soul Points from your opponent!

uno.name: UNO
uno.rules: The first player to discard all cards by matching color or number wins.

summary.label: How to Play
summary.title: Empty Your Hand!
summary.content: Match cards by number or color to get rid of them. It's fast, fun, and competitive!

cards.label: Cards
cards.title: Action Cards!
cards.content:
🔄 [Reverse] Changes the direction of play.
🚫 [Skip] The next player loses their turn.
➕2 [Draw Two] The next player must draw 2 cards.
🌈 [Wild] Change the current color to anything you want!

win.label: Winning
win.title: Shout 'UNO'!
win.content: When you have only 1 card left, shout 'UNO!' before anyone else notices. Discard your last card to win!

mancala.name: Mancala
mancala.description: One of the oldest board games. Sow seeds and collect them in your store.
mancala.rules: Choose a pit on your side and drop seeds one by one in a clockwise direction. The player with the most seeds in their store at the end wins.

summary.label: How to Play
summary.title: Sow and Collect!
summary.content: One of the oldest games in the world! You pick up seeds from a pit and 'sow' them one by one around the board to collect them in your 'Store'.

flow.label: Flow
flow.title: Sow the Seeds!
flow.content:
1. Pick all seeds from one pit on your side.
2. Drop one seed into each pit moving counter-clockwise.
3. If your last seed lands in your Store, you get another turn!

special.label: Capture
special.title: Steal from Opponent!
special.content: If your last seed lands in an empty pit on your side, you capture that seed and all seeds in the opposite pit for your Store!

sudoku.name: Sudoku
sudoku.description: Classic number placement puzzle on a 9×9 grid.
sudoku.rules: Fill the 9×9 grid so that every row, column, and 3×3 box contains the digits 1 through 9 exactly once.

summary.label: How to Play
summary.title: Fill the Numbers!
summary.content: Sudoku is a logic puzzle where you place numbers from 1 to 9 into a grid. Use your brain to fill every square!

rules.label: Rules
rules.title: No Duplicates!
rules.content:
1. [Row] Each horizontal line must have 1-9.
2. [Column] Each vertical line must have 1-9.
3. [Block] Each 3x3 square must also have 1-9.

goal.label: Goal
goal.title: Sudoku Master!
goal.content: The game ends when all 81 squares are filled correctly. Double check for any mistakes!

mahjong.name: Mahjong
mahjong.rules: A traditional game where 4 players draw and discard tiles to complete a winning hand.

summary.label: How to Play
summary.title: Match Tiles with 4 Players!
summary.content: Use 'Man', 'Pin', 'Sou', and 'Honor' tiles to complete a winning hand. 4 players take turns drawing and discarding tiles.

rules.label: Rules
rules.title: Aim for a Winning Hand!
rules.content:
1. A basic winning hand consists of 4 sets (melds) of 3 tiles and 1 pair (eye), totaling 14 tiles.
2. You can call 'Pon' or 'Chii' on other players' discards, but be careful as it may limit your possible hands.

win.label: Winning
win.title: Build Hands for Points!
win.content: The player with the most points at the end wins! Aim for high-scoring hands to secure victory.

wordle.name: Wordle
wordle.description: A puzzle game where you guess a 5-letter word.
wordle.rules: Guess the 5-letter word in 6 tries. After each guess, the color of the tiles will change to show how close your guess was to the word.

summary.label: Summary
summary.title: Guess the 5-letter Word!
summary.content: Wordle is a puzzle game where you have to uncover a hidden 5-letter English word. Use the feedback to narrow down the possibilities!

rules.label: Rules
rules.title: Use Color Hints!
rules.content:
1. Enter a 5-letter word and press ENTER.
2. Green tile: The letter is in the word and in the correct spot.
3. Yellow tile: The letter is in the word but in the wrong spot.
4. Gray tile: The letter is not in the word in any spot.

win.label: Winning
win.title: Find the word in 6 tries!
win.content: The fewer guesses you take, the better! Think carefully before each entry.

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: The classic card game 'Speed'. Race to play cards with rank ±1!
speed.rules: Play cards from your hand to the center piles if the rank is one higher or lower (A-2...K-A). Hand is auto-refilled from the deck. First to empty hand and deck wins. Use the 'Stuck' button to flip new cards if no moves are possible.

summary.label: What kind of game?
summary.title: A high-speed card race!
summary.content: A two-player card game where you race to play all your cards. Match the center piles with sequential numbers as fast as you can!

rules.label: Rules
rules.title: Play ±1 rank cards!
rules.content:
1. Look at your 5-card hand. You can play a card if it's one rank different from either center pile.
2. A (Ace) connects to both '2' and 'K' (King).
3. Your hand automatically replenishes from your personal deck.

stuck.label: Stuck?
stuck.title: Click the 'Stuck' button!
stuck.content: If neither player has a valid move, both should click the 'Stuck' button to flip new cards from the side piles to the center.

minesweeper.name: Minesweeper
minesweeper.rules: The numbers on the board indicate the number of mines in the adjacent 8 squares. Use them to uncover all safe squares to win.

summary.label: About
summary.title: Clear the cells avoiding mines!
summary.content: Minesweeper is a puzzle game where you must open all safe cells without stepping on a 'mine'!

rules.label: Rules
rules.title: Numbers are the key!
rules.content:
1. Click a cell to open it.
2. Right-click on a cell you think has a mine to place a flag.
3. The number in an opened cell tells you how many mines are in the surrounding 8 cells.

win.label: How to Win
win.title: Open all safe cells!
win.content: You win if you open all cells that don't have mines. If you click a mine, it's game over!

hakoiri_musume.name: Hakoiri Musume
hakoiri_musume.rules: Slide the blocks on a 4x5 board and move the 2x2 'daughter' block to the exit at the bottom center.

summary.label: About
summary.title: Escort the daughter to the exit!
summary.content: Slide the blocks on the board to move the largest 'daughter' block out through the exit at the bottom.

rules.label: Rules
rules.title: Slide into empty spaces!
rules.content:
1. You can move a block if there is an empty space next to it.
2. You cannot jump over or overlap other blocks.
3. Select a block and move it toward an empty direction!

win.label: Goal
win.title: The exit is at the bottom center!
win.content: Clear the game by moving the 'daughter' block (2x2 size) to the bottom center. Try to clear it in as few moves as possible!
